skip: The saved article has about 180 words of substance and adds little to the existing description. New in it: he died in 1061; he is said to have founded Rajahmahendravaram; he married Amangai Devi, daughter of Rajendra I, and was on his mother's side a grandson of Rajaraja Chola I; his son Rajendra Chalukya became the Chola king Kulottunga Chola I; Nannayya translated only two and a half parvas of the Mahabharata; the Aravidu dynasty of Vijayanagara claimed descent from him. The article gives no regnal dates.
